articles.title: Scientists find a possible weak spot in a top Alzheimer's risk gene
articles.summary: Two new studies suggest the Alzheimer's risk gene APOE4 can turn blood-vessel support cells into scar-making cells. Blocking one signal reversed the damage in mice.

articles.title: Sharks can hear sounds from nearly 250 feet away
articles.summary: Florida scientists used an underwater speaker and a drone to test blacktip sharks. The sharks noticed low sounds from up to 243 feet away and often turned away from the source.

articles.title: Why big female pythons may matter most in Florida
articles.summary: Florida hunts invasive Burmese pythons all year, but a new study says choosing targets carefully may work better. Researchers suggest focusing on large adult females, which lay around 70 eggs at a time.
